newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi, Marubeni mull Venezuela CVG privatisation.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi, Marubeni mull Venezuela CVG privatisation.

text.p: Japanese trading houses Mitsubishi Corp and Marubeni Corp said separately on Monday that they were interested in taking part in Venezuela's privatisation of aluminium group Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana (CVG).
Spokesmen for both companies said they were considering joining a consortium to participate in the privatisation of CVG.
They would not comment on whether they would be in the same consortium and declined to give further details.
The Venezuelan government is hoping to privatise CVG, which includes aluminium smelters Alcasa and Venalum, bauxite producer Bauxilum and anode producer Carbonorca, in the second half of this year.

So far 13 companies grouped in four consortiums have qualified to bid for the companies. They are: Alcoa and Alcan; Comalc, CRA Ltd-RTZ Corp Plc, Norsk Hydro and Reynolds Metals Co; Gencor/Billiton and Venezuela's Sural; Daewoo, Kaiser, Venezuela's Morgado and Dell Aqua.
